row: Welcome to my channel! I’m a Veterinary Technician student bringing you along for every paw-some moment of this wild journey. From hands-on experiences to behind the scenes moments, I’ll show you everything it takes to become an RVT. If you love animals or want to know what Vet Tech life is really like, you’re in the right place!
